## What I do

- LLM document-intelligence pipelines (RAG on Azure OpenAI, Python) with validated accuracy
- Multi-agent orchestration (CrewAI/LangChain) with retrieval, validation and citation grounding
- Enterprise AI integration: Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Azure
- AI adoption programs: training, opportunity mapping, AI-enabled delivery models
- Production discipline: Langfuse tracing, Sentry, DLP-aware design, auditability

## Experience

- **KPMG Brazil — Tax Transformation** (May 2025 – Jun 2026). Joined as AI Solutions
  Consultant, promoted to AI Engineer. Built LLM document-intelligence pipelines reaching
  94% validated accuracy with corporate tax professionals; delivered 30–80% execution-time
  reductions; trained 1,600+ professionals in responsible AI adoption.
- **Revisa Master — Co-founder & AI Engineer** (2023–present). Academic-services company
  where I own engineering end-to-end: production multi-agent review platform (Django,
  ChromaDB, Celery, Docker, Langfuse, Sentry) that cut a six-hour expert task
  to fifteen minutes. Built the funnels behind ~90% monthly revenue growth in one quarter.
- **Caju GameLabs — Software Engineer** (2024–2025). Led a 3-person Unity/C# team.

## Selected case studies (each has a dedicated page)

- **Revisa Express** (Python, Django, CrewAI, ChromaDB): production multi-agent academic
  review system structured around 5 evaluation pillars; cut first-pass expert analysis
  from ~6 hours to ~15 minutes; runs with Langfuse tracing and Sentry monitoring.
  https://leonardosa.pro/solutions/revisa-master-express
- **Document Analysis Automation** (Python, Power Automate, AI Builder, Copilot Studio):
  end-to-end pipeline that analyzed 50,000 scanned documents (1958–present) in 6 hours
  with 98% business-validated accuracy for an $8B legal dispute — replacing a sample-only
  manual review estimated at 5 consultants × 10 days.
  https://leonardosa.pro/solutions/document-analysis-automation
- **KBSE — Knowledge Base Search Engine** (Python, CrewAI, RAG, Azure): multi-agent
  semantic search for legal/tax knowledge bases. Decomposed reasoning into retrieval,
  consolidation, validation and answer generation with explicit citations. 94% validated
  answer accuracy. https://leonardosa.pro/solutions/knowledge-base-search-engine
- **Saving Time App**: offline-first consulting app — AI transcription/summarization,
  zero manual reporting. https://leonardosa.pro/solutions/saving-time-app
- **Tax Reform Delivery Model** (service design + AI accelerators): redesigned KPMG's
  delivery model into a 6-phase AI-enabled lifecycle; 30–80% efficiency gains.
  https://leonardosa.pro/solutions/tax-reform-delivery-model
- **AI Opportunity Mapping**: 12-hour workshop producing 6+ deployable solutions.
  https://leonardosa.pro/solutions/ai-opportunity-mapping
- **AI Training for ALL**: designed and delivered AI enablement for 1,600+ tax
  professionals (CARTS prompting framework, hands-on business cases).
  https://leonardosa.pro/solutions/ai-training-for-all
- **Lei do Bem Form Analysis**: R&D tax-incentive review from sample-based to full
  coverage. https://leonardosa.pro/solutions/lei-do-bem-form-analysis
